questions: What should happen if the table exists but has no rows (only a header row or empty)? Should it write an empty CSV or skip writing?
Should the CSV include headers from <th> elements, or only data from <td> elements?
If the CSV file already exists, should it always be removed before writing, or should it be overwritten? The reference removes if exists, but spec doesn't mandate.
What encoding should be used when reading the HTML or writing the CSV? The reference uses default, but could affect non-ASCII characters.
Should the function handle multiple tables with class 'data-table', or only the first one?
What should be the CSV delimiter? Comma? The reference uses csv.writer default (comma), but not specified.
Should cell text be stripped of whitespace/newlines, or kept raw? The reference uses tr.text which includes whitespace.
If the URL is unreachable or returns non-HTML, should the function raise an exception or return something else? The reference raises from urlopen, but spec doesn't define error handling.
